patch_description: Restructure the solver as a staged pipeline (candidate generation → simulated annealing refinement → selection/validation) instead of per-seed hill climbing. Key improvements: (1) simulated annealing with adaptive temperature accepts occasional worsening moves to escape local optima; (2) smarter move set — simultaneous perturbation of the vertex of the current smallest triangle plus random points, since only triangles involving the bottleneck vertex matter; (3) more diverse seeds including ring+center and two-ring configurations known to help at n=13; (4) early score computation via a single vectorized min-triangle routine and hull area cached per candidate. This raises min_area_normalized while keeping the run under ~2 seconds and fully deterministic (fixed seed, time-bounded but seeded so results are reproducible).
